deviations.what: t7 criterion 4 narrowed to spec c47's wording: on the public Host a request carrying the Access JWT alone needs an allow-listed Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin; a JWT plus the correct install secret as an Authorization Bearer header is vouched for by the header (a cross-site page cannot set it), as guard rule 5 already reasons; the secret cookie and a wrong bearer do not vouch
deviations.reason: the stricter reading broke t3's test_the_verifier_is_an_assertion_verifier_the_guard_admits (JWT + bearer, no Origin); c47 says 'admitted by Access JWT alone'; operator approved accepting it on 2026-10-23
